description: Fires on a fixed checkerboard of colours on the lower left-centre, seen from the player to move: column 2 has their stone at row 1 with mine on top, column 4 has mine at row 1 with theirs on top, and column 5 has theirs at the bottom with mine above. Columns 0-1 stay at most one stone high and column 3 stays low. Swapping colours or stacking columns 0-1 turns it off. Partial matches fire more weakly.
effect: Small: when strongly active it slightly lowers column 3 (about 5-9 points at most) and moves that probability to neighbouring columns; zeroing it in top positions changes moves by under 0.1.
notes: Layer-3 unit that acts like a distributed fixed-cell colour template, not a tactical concept. No threats or wins are involved, and the colour depends on who is to move. Minimal pairs agree cell by cell: (1,2)=them, (2,2)=me, (1,4)=me, (2,4)=them, (0,5)=them, (1,5)=me each add, and the left and right halves combine roughly like an AND. Hand-weighted template: F1 0.28 -> 0.45 -> 0.52 (AUROC 0.74), sim share 0.43. Misses are partial or variant patterns, so it may be a mixture. Synthesis reaches 13.5 vs dev max 10.9.
